detail: Review the expected fleet bill and your daily limit. Actual payment can be lower when departmental funding is insufficient; there is no loan or immediate spending from this confirmation.
requirements: This ceiling uses the existing Defense maintenance allocation. No cash is paid merely by setting the plan; actual daily invoices use the shared fiscal ledger once. Unused authorization stays available until normal fiscal expiry.
Invoices are allocated proportionally across inherited and custom equipment when the ceiling or funding is insufficient. More money cannot restore age-related condition or deploy refit reservations.
Inherited equipment upkeep is a game assumption of 4% of its catalog purchase value per year, spread over 365 days. Custom revisions use their frozen per-vehicle daily requirement.

Activating this plan replaces the automatic maintenance allocation expense prospectively. Existing receipts and other departments remain unchanged; old campaign saves retain their previous support behavior until activation.
